text.p: These are the main stories in Latvian newspapers on Monday. Prepared for Reuters by the Co-operation Fund. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:

- Eight children plunged to their death on Saturday and 22 were injured when a basket snapped from a crane during a firefighting show in the small Latvian town of Talsi. A criminal investigation has been launched and today has been declared a national day of mourning.
- The Union of Christian Democrats and the People's Christian Party held a congress on Saturday to merge into one party, the Christian Democratic Union.
- Latvia's national womens' basketball team was attacked on Saturday and robbed by an armed gang after its bus stopped by a gas station near the Slovak town of Zlate Muravce.
- Riga authorities plan to buy 46 Mercedes-Benz buses and 32 Skoda trolley-buses this October by using a loan from the World Bank.
